cases.name: Susan C. “Sue” Zittel
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Sue graduated from Columbus High School. After college, she was employed at the Kodak Company in Rochester, NY." She and her husband owned and operated Lyco Manufacturing in Columbus, WI.
